title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Frontline User Billing
content:
How frontline users are billed in the monthly fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement follows the frontline seat rule, which reads the license quantity of the client's active Microsoft 365 F3 subscription held under Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP).

**Rule.**
1. With 10 or more F3 licenses, those seats are taken out of the billed seats, the remaining billed seats are billed at the per-seat rate, each of the first 9 frontline users (10 less one) is billed 11.50 USD and each further frontline user is billed at 50 percent of the per-seat rate.
2. With one up to 9 F3 licenses, those seats are taken out of the billed seats, the remaining billed seats are billed at the per-seat rate and each frontline user is billed 11.50 USD, never more than the per-seat rate.
3. With no active F3 subscription, every billed seat is billed at the per-seat rate.

The F3 seats so treated never exceed the billed seats: when the F3 licenses outnumber the billed seats, only as many frontline users as there are billed seats are treated.

**Worked figures (hypothetical: 30 billed seats at 120.00 per seat).**

| Active F3 licenses | Seats at 120.00 | Frontline users at 11.50 | Further frontline users at 60.00 | Seat amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 30 | 0 | 0 | 3600.00 |
| 4 | 26 | 4 | 0 | 3120.00 plus 46.00, that is 3166.00 |
| 10 | 20 | 9 | 1 | 2400.00 plus 103.50 plus 60.00, that is 2563.50 |
| 14 | 16 | 9 | 5 | 1920.00 plus 103.50 plus 300.00, that is 2323.50 |
| 40 | 0 | 9 | 21 | 103.50 plus 1260.00, that is 1363.50 |

In the last row only 30 of the 40 licenses are treated, the billed seats being 30.
